[SWS_CM_10338] Invoke the registered set/get handlers - event driven
⌈
In case
a MethodCallProcessingMode of either kEvent or kEventSingleThread has
been passed to the constructor of the ServiceSkeleton (see [SWS_CM_00130]),
the deserialized payload containing the method data (i.e., method ID and input ar-
guments) shall be used to invoke a registered SetHandler resp.
GetHandler
(see [SWS_CM_00114] and [SWS_CM_00116]) of the Field class as a conse-
quence to the reception of the SOME/IP request message.
⌋
